title: README 'Enumeration & ranking' snippet errors verbatim on the candidate venv (bf16 logits rejected by the 1e-4 normalization check)
reproduction: cd <workdir>; copy the README snippet verbatim into s6.py (prepend `import os; os.environ['HF_HUB_OFFLINE']='1'` if the model is cached); run `<review-root>/candidate-081/venv/bin/python s6.py`. Installed transformers is 5.16.1 (inside the wheel's declared range `transformers<6,>=4.40`).
expected: Prints [' located in the', ' the city of', ' the capital of'] and rank=6, cumulative_prob=0.114 as the README shows.
observed: ValueError at continuations.top_k(3): 'next_logprobs returned a non-normalized distribution (kept probabilities sum to 0.998532, expected ~1.0)'. Cause: transformers 5.x `from_pretrained` honours the checkpoint dtype, so llm.dtype is torch.bfloat16 and the bf16 log_softmax exponentiates to 0.99853; mixle/enumeration/autoregressive.py `_parse_steps` rejects |sum-1| > _NORM_TOL = 1e-4.
notes: Adding `dtype=torch.float32` to from_pretrained makes the snippet run and reproduces the README's printed outputs exactly (top-3 tokens, unrank(5) -> ' Paris, the', rank=6, cumulative_probability=0.11397). Either the README must pin float32 or _parse_steps must tolerate reduced-precision normalization (or renormalize).
